classes.name: CoordinationLeaseLifecycleModule
classes.description: Transport-independent module that owns coordination-lease authorization, persistence orchestration, object-bound key parsing, and guarded-mutation precondition validation.

classes.name: SekaiGrpcTransportAdapter
classes.description: gRPC adapter that authenticates callers, enforces tenant and team-namespace admission, and maps protocol messages and errors around domain modules.

classes.name: GuardedObjectMutation
classes.description: Object create, update, or delete operation fenced by a coordination-lease precondition.

classes.name: ObjectBoundLeasePrecondition
classes.description: Canonical object:<object_id> lease key whose object identity and namespace must match an existing-object mutation and which cannot guard object creation.

relations.name: delegates_lease_lifecycle_to
relations.description: The gRPC transport delegates transport-independent coordination-lease behavior to the lease lifecycle module.

relations.name: validates_guarded_mutation
relations.description: The lease lifecycle module validates object identity and namespace invariants before a guarded object mutation crosses the persistence seam.

relations.name: is_fenced_by_object_bound_lease
relations.description: An existing-object guarded mutation may be fenced by a canonical object-bound lease precondition validated by the lease lifecycle module.
